why: The answer depends on the sign and size of m: a negative m means an inverted real image (only a concave mirror can form one), a positive m means a virtual erect image, and of the positive cases only m less than 1 can come from a convex mirror, since a convex mirror always gives a diminished virtual image.
note: The match-the-column table is mangled in the text layer; read from papers_v2/crops/2016_X/q165.png - Column 1 is m = -2, -1/2, +2, +1/2 and Column 2 is convex mirror, concave mirror, real image, virtual image.
